references.text: Bet-Dagon is also mentioned in the territory of Asher, showing that the name of this city, linked to the Philistine god Dagon, appeared in several places in Canaan.
Dagon was the chief god of the Philistines, and Bet-Dagon means 'House of Dagon,' demonstrating the religious influence of the Philistines in the region.
Makkedah is mentioned in connection with Joshua's conquest of the Canaanite kings who hid in a cave there.
Joshua captured Makkedah, struck it with the sword, and devoted it to destruction along with its king.
The king of Makkedah is listed among the defeated kings whom Joshua overcame.
